• **Daily Draw:** Every day 5 four-digit numbers (1st to 5th prizes) are drawn.

• **Board:** Splits payout across all 5 prizes (1st to 5th).

• Betting on Ram on Head pays **18x**!
• Betting on tens 28 on Head pays **60x**!
